body:
Worker rule (Termal::BarA1, 2026-10-19 08:30Z, my own miss on the w-4d6283a1f1f5 GREEN-6 gate test-c85d2a3d). Before mailing READY for a full gate, pre-flight the root with reads only: `<root>\ui
ode_modules	ypescript in	sc` exists, and `<root>\ui
ode_modules` is NOT a junction (LinkType empty). If I unlinked a junctioned node_modules earlier in that root (the correct non-recursive removal), the root has NO node_modules until its own `npm ci` runs. Then the gate dies before any stage with ENOENT on ui
ode_modules	ypescript in	sc, earns no credit ("terminal record has no input fingerprint") and burns a gate slot. Fix: ask the coordinator for an npm ci window (heavy disk; never during the other project's gate), run `pushd "<root>\ui" && npm ci` as its own command, verify, then ask for a fresh LAUNCH NOW. Rules: coordinator-fresh-worktree-npm-ci, no-node-modules-junction-for-test-roots, termal-worktree-node-modules-rule.
